authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6778 dhānyà explicitly gives Assamese/Bengali dhān growing or unhusked rice and Oriya dhāna. The eastern survey dhan/dʰan paddy-rice responses match this grain family, including the elicited unhusked sense; source vowel-length and aspiration notation are retained. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: dhan.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4889 cūrṇa sense 3 explicitly gives Bengali cūṇ/cūṇā, Assamese sūṇ and Oriya cūna lime. Survey tśun/tʃun/cun and Bishnupriya śunu fit this eastern lime family, retaining affricate/sibilant and final-vowel variation. Betelnut specifies use of the lime, not a citrus-fruit sense. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: śunu.
